name: GASMSIA
recent: Gas Malaysia 在2026年11月24日公布截至9月30日的第三季度业绩，净利按年上升约10%至1.047亿令吉，但营收下滑。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）在10月底至11月中多次申报股权变动。此外，公司提名与薪酬委员会出现人事变动。
notable: 2026年第三季度净利按年上升约10%至1.047亿令吉，但营收下降。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在10月底至11月中多次申报股权变动。
退休基金局（KWAP）在10月底至11月初多次申报股权变动。
risks: 2026年第三季度营收按年下降12.1%，按季下降0.4%。
2026年第三季度净利按季下降21.9%，按年下降26.8%（基于上一季度对比）。
2026年第三季度净利率为4.6%，低于上一季度的5.8%。
earnings: 最新财报（截至2026年6月30日）显示，营收为15.848亿令吉，净利为7252.9万令吉，净利率4.6%。营收按年下降12.1%，净利按年下降26.8%；按季比较，营收下降0.4%，净利下降21.9%。

recent_en: Gas Malaysia announced its third-quarter results for the period ended September 30 on November 24, 2026, with net profit rising about 10% year-on-year to RM104.7 million despite lower revenue. Meanwhile, the Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) and Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (KWAP) filed multiple changes in shareholding between late October and mid-November. The company also saw changes in its Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
notable_en: 3Q 2026 net profit rose about 10% year-on-year to RM104.7 million, while revenue declined.
The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple changes in shareholding from late October to mid-November.
Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (KWAP) filed multiple changes in shareholding from late October to early November.
risks_en: 3Q 2026 net income fell 21.9% quarter-on-quarter and 26.8% year-on-year (based on prior quarter comparison).
3Q 2026 net margin was 4.6%, down from 5.8% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: The latest financials (for the period ended June 30, 2026) show revenue of RM1.58488 billion and net income of RM72.529 million, with a net margin of 4.6%. Revenue fell 12.1% year-on-year and net income fell 26.8% year-on-year; quarter-on-quarter, revenue declined 0.4% and net income declined 21.9%.
